evidence: app/app/pages/abilities/[name].vue:1-25 — whole feature is one page file
app/server/api/abilities/[name].get.ts:1-23 — its single handler in its own directory
app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:165-172 — the only inbound /abilities links, one bounded PageSection
app/app/composables/team.ts:22-46 — team feature isolated in one composable plus app/app/pages/team.vue, app/server/api/team.get.ts, app/app/components/SiteHeader.vue:8
removability.rationale: Features are page-directory + handler-directory + composable triples; removing Abilities is deleting two directories and excising one clearly bounded section. No nav or cross-feature references exist.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:54 — single sprite rule for server-built cards (cardsFor at :100)
app/app/pages/index.vue:48 — home page re-inlines the same sprite URL scheme, so that fix lands twice
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:39 vs app/app/composables/format.ts:1 — humanize duplicated verbatim server/client
app/app/composables/format.ts:30-37 — usePageData/usePageTitle centralize fetch/404 and title rules for every page
changeability.rationale: Most behaviour (fetching, 404s, titles, sorting, filtering, team rules) sits in one obvious place, but sprite URLs and humanization exist as server and client copies, making those specific fixes two-place.

evidence: app/app/composables/format.ts:30-37 — pages depend on the narrow usePageData(url, key) seam, not each other
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:57-62 — one withNotFound/NotFound 404 seam shared by all handlers
app/app/pages/team.vue:1-6 vs app/server/api/team.get.ts:1-6 — TeamMember declared on both sides of the HTTP boundary with no shared source of truth
app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:13-35 — PokemonData hand-mirrors the untyped output of app/server/api/pokemon/[name].get.ts
app/app/composables/team.ts:22-46 — shared state explicit via cookie + useState behind useTeam()
coupling.rationale: Components are prop-driven, pages talk only to their own /api endpoint, and server/client code is cleanly separated; the weak seam is response contracts re-declared in pages instead of shared with handlers, so they can drift silently.

evidence: app/app/components/CardList.vue:1-14 — one component renders 4 of 5 card lists via a plain cards prop
app/app/components/MovesTable.vue:13-26 — a single showLevel boolean matches the real Level-Up variation; column model stretches to new columns
app/app/components/PageSection.vue:1-14 — section/aria pattern factored once, used everywhere
app/app/pages/moves/[name].vue:49-52, app/app/pages/abilities/[name].vue:22-24 — '<count> Pokémon' + CardList block repeated inline in three pages
app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:72-108 — allTypes/typeLabels/cardsFor reused across handlers instead of copied
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track the app's real variation and were reused (not copied) for the team feature; a shared types module and a small cards-section component are the missing pieces that would make an Items-shaped extension cheaper.

findings.issue: Home page inlines the sprite URL scheme that app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:54 owns, so a sprite-source bug fix covers moves/abilities/types/team but not the home list.
findings.suggestion: Return sprite URLs from /api/species like the other endpoints, or extract a shared client helper both sides derive from.

findings.issue: Response contracts are duplicated across the HTTP boundary: TeamMember appears in both team.vue and server/api/team.get.ts, and PokemonData (app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:13-35) hand-mirrors the untyped handler output, so renames drift without compiler errors.
findings.suggestion: Move payload interfaces to a shared types module imported by both pages and handlers, extending the pattern already used for MoveRow/ChainNode component exports.

findings.issue: humanize is duplicated verbatim in app/app/composables/format.ts:1; a display-name change must be made twice.
findings.suggestion: Put name/format helpers in one shared module imported by server utils and app composables.

findings.issue: Type-label map building is repeated three ways: typeLabels() (pokeapi.ts:77), an inline Object.fromEntries here, and the usedTypes-derived map in app/server/api/pokemon/[name].get.ts:62.
findings.suggestion: Extend typeLabels() (or add labelFor(name)) and use it in every handler.

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' heading plus CardList block is copy-pasted across the moves, abilities and types pages, so changing that section needs three edits.
findings.suggestion: Fold the count into CardList or wrap it in a small PokemonListSection component.

findings.issue: usePageData collapses any fetch error into a 404 (statusCode ?? 404), rendering a server 500 as 'Not found'.
findings.suggestion: Pass the real statusCode through and reserve the Not found page for 404s.

summary: A well-factored, idiomatic Nuxt 4 codebase: features are page-plus-handler pairs behind narrow composables, 404s and titles each have a single seam, and card/section/table components absorb the app's real variation, so the team feature was grafted on without disturbing existing structure. The recurring editability tax is small client/server duplication — sprite URLs, humanize, and unshared response-shape interfaces — which turns a few one-line fixes into two-line fixes. I'd merge this with the two medium findings addressed.
